title: Golden's Better Enchanting
description: Overhauls the enchanting system to allow for collectable enchantments
body:
![Better Enchanting logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c9cf7dc9ef4e886504cb77425445ebd8cc0d410.png)

# Unlock Enchants
![Enchanting menu with selectable enchant icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93c93fbba9ee2b1fe4d30fcc9c3bf695aeb3e5a1.png)

Once you collect 6 books of any enchant and level in a nearby Chiseled Bookshelf (e.g 6 Efficiency V books), you now have access to that enchantment for free.

# Unlock Levels
![Enchanting table menu with a diamond pickaxe sitting in the encant slot, just having been enchanted with Efficiency 2.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/255a33390e7cd085798c429678889bd94903dcf4.png)

Starting out, the enchanting table will only give level 1 enchants, in order to receive higher levels you must have 6 books of the level below the level you want to receive. E.g 6 Effeciency 1 books to begin receiving Effeciency 2 via the random enchant.

# Increase Chance
![Chiseled bookshelf menu with 3 enchanted books](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea6b2eeae408d6cd2af8c8fc8d99bf4995af5a45_0.webp)

Each additional enchanted book put into a nearby chiseled bookshelf increases the odds of receiving that same enchant again randomly.

Though, once you have 6 enchanted books of a specific enchant, you won't receive it anymore randomly. This is so you can systematically collect enchants.

# Costs

Before you can collect 6 books, you'll need to randomly enchant some books. Random enchant costs now follow a scale based on how many levels it has divided by 30.

| Enchant | XP Levels | Enchant | XP Levels | Enchant | XP Levels |
| :---    | :---      | :---    | :---      | :---    | :---      |
| Efficiency 1 | 6    | Unbreaking 1 |  10  | Mending |  30  |
| Efficiency 2 | 12   | Unbreaking 2 |  20  |
| Efficiency 3 | 18   | Unbreaking 3 |  30  |
| Efficiency 4 | 24   |
| Efficiency 5 | 30   |
